$schema_note: Portable end-to-end AI video ad production spec. Feed to any capable agent platform (Manus, Genspark, Claude, custom). The agent must execute clips in order, obey every constraint, and run the qa_gate on every take before accepting. Asset files referenced live alongside this file in assets/stills/.

project.name: JCKED — The Locked Vault (Hook 3 teaser + full cut)
project.purpose: Cold-traffic Meta ad, mechanism-led education. Strategy: stalled fat loss reframed as a lock-and-key problem, not a discipline problem.
project.definition_of_done: A finished MP4 a DTC brand could launch today: graded, film-grain unified, burned captions in Inter Tight, one consistent VO voice, music bed ducked under VO, silence on the final CTA, final product close-up uses REAL photography (end card), zero AI text artifacts at freeze-frame.

product_photo.rule: This photo IS the product. Attach as reference on every product-visible generation. Never allow a model to redraw, restyle, or re-typeset the label. Never generate an extreme close-up of label text; the end card handles close-ups with this real photo.

narrator_ref.rule: Canonical narrator identity: same face, dark crewneck, neutral kitchen, warm side light, navy shadow. Attach as character reference on every narrator clip. Describe by appearance and delivery only; never use age words.

talking_human_with_dialogue.never: image-to-video for on-camera speech (dialogue suppression risk)

cinematic_broll.primary: veo-3.1 Quality via Flow, Frames-to-Video with start frame
cinematic_broll.fallback: seedance / kling for image-to-video label fidelity

stills_and_text_in_scene.rule: All in-scene readable text is baked into stills, never rendered by video models

settings_that_are_not_optional: 2 takes per clip, keep the better

brand_constraints_hard: No before/after bodies, no scales, no doctors or lab coats, no urgency stingers
Dose language: 'top of the studied range', never 'the clinical dose'
Palette locked: dark navy + matte steel + amber accents; editorial restraint, not gym-bro
No on-screen text or subtitles in any generation (captions are burned in post)
VO lines are verbatim; one word changed = reject

audio_strategy.vo: ALL non-dialogue clips generate SILENT (ambient/SFX only). One VO voice records the full script (ElevenLabs or equivalent: calm, declarative, lightly conspiratorial, measured pace) and is laid over in the edit so the voice is identical across every clip.
audio_strategy.dialogue_clips: Narrator hooks may use native model dialogue; if voice varies between takes, mute and use the recorded VO with lip-sync tooling.
audio_strategy.music: Sparse low pulse at -18 dB under VO; full silence under the final CTA line.

finishing_pass_required.note: THIS is what makes it look paid-for. Raw generations are not the deliverable.
steps: Assemble hard cuts per clip order; trim dead frames
One unifying color grade across all clips (match to the navy/amber reference still)
Add 2-3% film grain uniformly so clips from different models read as one camera
Burn captions: Inter Tight, bottom third above 350px safe area, max 6 words per cue, amber color ONLY on 'CPT-1' and dose numbers
Lay single recorded VO across the full cut; duck music -18dB under VO; hard silence under final CTA line
END CARD (final 3s): the REAL product photo on dark pedestal composition, offer line 'First bottle $49.95', guarantee line '365-day money-back guarantee' — this replaces any generated label close-up
Loudness normalize -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP; export H.264 1080x1920 30fps

qa_gate_every_take: No burned-in text or subtitles anywhere
Label matches the real photo at its largest on-screen size; CPT-1 spelled correctly
Nothing in frame the prompt did not name (people, hands, candy, particles)
Palette holds navy+amber; no daylight or teal drift versus the other clips
One steady camera move; no end-of-clip freeze, shimmer, or morph
Narrator identical to reference across takes (face, wardrobe, kitchen)
